$comment: Mission 1.69 §40. Whether the rule Mission 1.68 offered has found a second independent instance. It has not, and the registry does not grow.
mission: 1.69 — Independent Product-Relevant Quantity Class Selection V1

candidate_requirement.name: A_PUBLISHED_SURFACE_IS_THE_SALEABLE_OBSERVATION_NOT_THE_MEASUREMENT_PIPELINE
candidate_requirement.meaning: Where an apparatus performs a multi-stage measurement and publishes only the stage its customers buy, the earlier stages are not retrievable however thoroughly they are performed.

candidate_second_instances_examined.shape: An aggregate is published and the underlying per-request events are not separately addressable.
candidate_second_instances_examined.why: The shape rattles the same way and the mechanism is different. PyPI is not a measurement apparatus publishing one stage of its own pipeline; it is a service whose logs are a byproduct of delivering files. That case is already covered by SOURCE_EXCLUSIVE_METRIC, which says the quantity exists only because the platform recorded it. Filing it under the new rule would put one distinction in two places.

candidate_second_instances_examined.candidate: GH Archive and the GitHub Events API
candidate_second_instances_examined.shape: An archive republishes what a platform reports.
candidate_second_instances_examined.why: Here the events ARE published. Nothing is withheld; the archive is simply not a second producer. That is the mirror trap, a different rule.
Same reason. It is aggregation, not a withheld pipeline stage.

the_standard_applied: Mission 1.66.2 offered APPARATUS_CONFIGURATION_MUST_BE_UNIFORM_ACROSS_THE_FRAME and Mission 1.67 adopted it only after finding a second independent instance in a DIFFERENT SHAPE. The same standard is applied here, and the candidates found this mission are the same shape as rules the registry already has rather than a second shape of this one.
